subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger selection wait for a structured metadata contract?
rationale: Current main still uses `description` as the prompt-visible selection signal, but repository docs and related issues show a real tradeoff between concise descriptions, prompt budget, and a possible future `triggers` contract.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update for existing bundled skills, keeping wording short and avoiding broad NOT-FOR churn.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact for now and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that current concise descriptions are intentional and close partial trigger-phrase PRs as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update for existing bundled skills, keeping wording short and avoiding broad NOT-FOR churn.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history signal for bundled skill metadata and guidance policy among the sampled files.
